messages:
Asha: Anyone up for a quick after-work taco run tonight? Looking for a dog-friendly patio near SFO/SoMa around 6:30–7pm. Mostly GF options needed for my partner's sister. 🐶🌮
Ben: Count me in. Food trucks by the piers? Dogs allowed at Seawall but need a table. Coqueta has a small patio but it's $$$. :thinking_face:
Riley: Not Coqueta — pricier. There's "Pier 23 Taqueria" (very casual) or Dogpatch Tacos on 3rd St — huge outdoor area, dog-friendly, good GF corn tortillas.
Sam: FYI El Tejado on 5th has dog bowls and a covered patio. Brought my corgi there last month.
Asha: Nice recs. Which spot has vegan options and zero-cross-contam concern for GF?
Jules: Dogpatch Tacos does jackfruit and they have separate prep for corn tortillas AFAIK. Also staff are chill about swaps.
Ben: Heads up — parking near Dogpatch is tight. BART to 22nd St then a 10-min walk is easier.
Riley: I can DM the host and snag a high-top for 6:45 if we want. How many ppl + dogs?
Asha: 6 humans, 2 small dogs. Thank you! ❤️
lunch-bot: quick reminder: you can add this to the team calendar with `/add_event SFO tacos 18:45` (automated suggestion).
Sam: I'll bring a collapsible water bowl and some extra napkins. :dog: :bowl_with_spoon:
Jules: +1 for Dogpatch. See y'all at 6:45 — bringing SPF for sunset seating. ☀️
